import pyautogui, time
# open Save As dialog
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 's')
time.sleep(1.0)
# type full path and filename to save on Desktop
pyautogui.typewrite('/home/user/Desktop/price.docx', interval=0.03)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1.0)
# If a confirmation dialog appears (e.g., overwrite), press 'enter' to confirm
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
